description:
Evaluate the predictive accuracy of a Probit model on female labor force participation.

Using the loaded 'mroz.gdt' dataset:
1. Estimate a Probit model with 'lfp' (labor force participation) as the dependent variable.
2. Use the following independent variables: const, k5, k618, age, wc, hc, inc.
3. Generate the classification (Expectation-Prediction) table for this model. (Hint: Analysis > Forecast/Prediction... or via the 'Tests' or 'Analysis' menu in the model window, look for classification/evaluation).
4. Save the full text output of the classification table to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/classification_report.txt'.
5. Identify the 'Percent correctly predicted' value (e.g., 65.4) and save ONLY this numeric value to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/accuracy_score.txt'.
